# 引言

<p>该回测系统采用三重技术指标组合策略，主要逻辑架构如下：</p>

## 核心策略逻辑

<ul>
<li><p>趋势判断层：通过EMA(12)与EMA(26)双均线组合识别中期趋势方向，当快线上穿慢线时判定为上升趋势。</p></li>
<li><p>动量验证层：计算快线EMA(12)的ROC(9)指标，确保价格变动具备持续动能。</p></li>
<li><p>趋势过滤层：引入SMA(200)作为长期趋势基准，要求价格必须位于年线上方才允许做多。</p></li>
</ul>

## 信号生成机制

<p>多头信号触发条件（同时满足）：</p>
<ul>
<li>EMA(12) &gt; EMA(26)（双均线金叉）</li>
<li>ROC(9) &gt; 0（正向动量确认）</li>
<li>收盘价 &gt; SMA(200)（处于长期上升趋势）</li>
</ul>
<p>空头信号触发条件（同时满足）：</p>
<ul>
<li>EMA(12) &lt; EMA(26)（双均线死叉）</li>
<li>ROC(9) &lt; 0（负向动量确认）</li>
<li>收盘价 &lt; SMA(200)（处于长期下降趋势）</li>
</ul>

## 风险控制设计

<ul>
<li>采用固定100股交易量简化头寸管理。</li>
<li>通过quantstrat的ruleSignal机制实现市价单即时成交。</li>
<li>绩效分析模块自动计算夏普比率、最大回撤等关键指标57</li>
</ul>
<p>该策略通过多指标协同验证，既保留EMA对趋势的敏感度，又利用SMA过滤假突破信号，同时ROC指标确保入场时点具备足够动能。回测框架严格遵循事件驱动原则，模拟真实交易中的订单撮合流程</p>

``` r
library(TTR)
library(PerformanceAnalytics)
library(xts)
library(quantmod)
# 设置环境选项
options(width = 240)
Sys.setenv(TZ = "GMT")

# 清理旧的策略对象
if (exists(".strategy", envir = globalenv())) {
    strategy_env <- get(".strategy", envir = globalenv())
    strategy_objects <- ls(strategy_env)
    for (obj in strategy_objects) {
        rm(list = obj, envir = strategy_env)
    }
}

# 清理投资组合相关对象
if (exists(".blotter", envir = globalenv())) {
    blotter_env <- get(".blotter", envir = globalenv())
    blotter_objects <- ls(blotter_env)
    for (obj in blotter_objects) {
        rm(list = obj, envir = blotter_env)
    }
}


# 1. 初始化环境
currency("USD")
```


``` r
stock("AAPL", currency="USD", multiplier=1)
```


``` r
initDate <- "2010-01-01"
endDate <- "2025-05-25"
initEq <- 100000

# 2. 优化后的策略函数
rocEmaStrategy <- function(priceData, 
                          fastEMA = 12, 
                          slowEMA = 26, 
                          rocPeriod = 9,
                          smaFilter = 200) {
  # 计算三重技术指标
  fastMA <- EMA(Cl(priceData), fastEMA)
  slowMA <- EMA(Cl(priceData), slowEMA)
  roc <- ROC(fastMA, rocPeriod)
  trendFilter <- SMA(Cl(priceData), smaFilter)  # 新增SMA趋势过滤器
  
  # 生成交易信号
  signal <- ifelse(
    fastMA > slowMA & roc > 0 & Cl(priceData) > trendFilter, 1,
    ifelse(
      fastMA < slowMA & roc < 0 & Cl(priceData) < trendFilter, -1, 
      0
    )
  )
  xts(na.locf(signal), order.by=index(priceData))
}

# 3. 回测配置
strategy.st <- "enhanced_roc_ema"
portfolio.st <- "quant"
account.st <- "quant"

# 清除旧策略
suppressWarnings(rm.strat(strategy.st))

# 初始化组合
initPortf(portfolio.st, "AAPL", initDate=initDate)
```

```
## [1] "quant"
```

``` r
initAcct(account.st, portfolios=portfolio.st, 
        initDate=initDate, initEq=initEq)
```

```
## [1] "quant"
```

``` r
initOrders(portfolio.st, initDate=initDate)
strategy(strategy.st, store=TRUE)

# 4. 添加策略组件
add.indicator(strategy.st, name="rocEmaStrategy",
             arguments=list(priceData=quote(mktdata),
                          fastEMA=12, slowEMA=26,
                          rocPeriod=9, smaFilter=200),
             label="signal")
```

```
## [1] "enhanced_roc_ema"
```

``` r
# 交易信号规则
add.signal(strategy.st, name="sigThreshold",
          arguments=list(column="signal",
                        threshold=0.5, 
                        relationship="gt"),
          label="longEntry")
```

```
## [1] "enhanced_roc_ema"
```

``` r
add.signal(strategy.st, name="sigThreshold",
          arguments=list(column="signal",
                        threshold=-0.5,
                        relationship="lt"),
          label="shortEntry")
```

```
## [1] "enhanced_roc_ema"
```

``` r
# 交易执行规则
add.rule(strategy.st, name="ruleSignal",
        arguments=list(sigcol="longEntry", sigval=TRUE,
                      orderqty=100, ordertype="market",
                      orderside="long", replace=FALSE,
                      prefer="Open"),
        type="enter")
```

```
## [1] "enhanced_roc_ema"
```

``` r
add.rule(strategy.st, name="ruleSignal",
        arguments=list(sigcol="shortEntry", sigval=TRUE,
                      orderqty=-100, ordertype="market",
                      orderside="short", replace=FALSE,
                      prefer="Open"),
        type="enter")
```

```
## [1] "enhanced_roc_ema"
```

``` r
# 5. 执行回测
getSymbols("AAPL", from=initDate, to=endDate, adjust=TRUE)
```

```

```

``` r
applyStrategy(strategy.st, portfolio.st)
```
